text:
mia.marketing: Draft for product launch blog is live: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft-2026. Need quick passes on hero claim, benchmark callout under hero, webinar CTA copy, and form/UTM mapping. EOD please.

own.product: Quick skim 1 looks solid. Suggest hero: 'Redwood Inference 1 predictable, production LLM serving that can cut per-token inference cost by up to ~40% on common batch/latency profiles.'

mina.content: Put a one-line stat card under hero: 'Benchmark snapshot: up to ~40% lower per-token cost vs baseline single-instance serving*' then footnote. Shorten intro paragraph.

claire.legal: Quickpass: use 'can cut' or 'can reduce' and keep 'up to'. Footnote required: '*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results vary by model, sequence length, batch size, and config. See appendix for methodology and run dates.' Add privacy blurb by form: 'By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; data stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy.' No competitor names unless publicly cited.

noah.growth: UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2. Hidden field 'launch_interest'. Registration select: [Attend live, Watch recording, Pilot/case-study]. I'll map to HubSpot after publish lock. Also ask sales to add 'launch_interest' to lead routing rules.

kai.design: Will do a small hero stats card + CTA. Need final CTA text and 3-line 'what you'll learn'.

mia.marketing: Draft CTA: 'Register: Live launch walkthrough + cost playbook'
What you'll learn:
- Unit-cost levers and benchmark context
- Deployment checklist for Dedicated & Private options
- Live demo + Q&A with product team
Link: /events/launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Privacy note included per legal.

publish-bot: Reminder: publish window opens in 36 hours. Final approvals due by 4pm PT tomorrow.

claire.legal: Approved with footnote + privacy line.

own.product: Approved 1 fixed a tiny phrasing nit.

mina.content: Approved. Minor copy tidy.

kai.design: Approved on layout; will deliver assets by EOD tomorrow.

noah.growth: +1 on UTMs and fields. Will prepare HubSpot mapping after lock.

mia.marketing: Thanks all ":tada:" locking content and kicking design + HubSpot handoff.
